failures.firstSql:
-- 按英文类目与退款原因聚合退款笔数（按退款单去重）与退款金额（按明细金额求和）
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       r.reason_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS refund_amount
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english, r.reason_code
ORDER BY refund_count DESC, refund_amount DESC
LIMIT 20;
